name: Mark Guest Value Claimable
summary: Promotes detected guest-created value into a stable claimable state without creating an account.

preconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and claimable-value == detected and durable-identity == absent

setup: Associate detected value with the active guest identity.

postconditions.expression: guest-identity == active and claimable-value == claimable and durable-identity == absent
